class.name: IfcAddress
class.brief_description: Definition: An abstract entity type for various kinds of postal and telecom addresses. NOTE Corresponds to the following entity in ISO-10303-41: address. HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 1.5.1.

members.member: Identifies the logical location of the address. A String, one of the enumeration's values, or null when unset.
Text that relates the nature of the address. A String, or null when unset.

Allows for specification of user specific purpose of the address beyond the enumeration values provided by Purpose attribute of type IfcAddressTypeEnum. When a value is provided for attribute UserDefinedPurpose, in parallel the attribute Purpose shall have enumeration value USERDEFINED. A String, or null when unset.
